observation.command:
cd /workspace && pkill -f 'sva-studio-react:serve' 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'run-executor.js' 2>/dev/null; sleep 3
echo "remaining: $(ps -eo pid,args | grep -c '[s]va-studio-react:serve')"
nohup pnpm exec tsx /tmp/launch-app2.mjs > /tmp/launch4.log 2>&1 & sleep 4; cat /tmp/launch4.log
for i in $(seq 1 40); do
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 5 http://localhost:3000/health/live 2>/dev/null)
  [ "$code" = "200" ] && { echo "live up after ~$((i*5))s"; break; }
  sleep 5
done
